title: BIS - acquisition of Allied Plant Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: BIS - acquisition of Allied Plant Services.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered BIS' acquisition of Allied Plant Services in the context of the national market for the provision of logistics and equipment hire to mining and industrial customers.
body_sections.Competition analysis: In reaching its conclusion not to oppose BIS' acquisition of Allied Plant Services, the ACCC took into account, amongst other factors: - the small increase in market concentration as a result of the acquisition; - relatively low barriers to entry, especially for companies operating in related industries; - a number of alternative suppliers of logistics and equipment hire to BIS and Allied Plant Services; and - customers of BIS and Allied Plant Services continue to possess countervailing power post-acquisition.
